metadata.scope: Evidence lineage from origin to certification

mutation_runner.py:execute_mutation.exit_code: 0 (Gate A & B pass, Gate C pass), 1 (Gate A or B fail), 2 (Gate C fail)

orchestrator.py:execute.lineage: VERIFIED - run manifest joins planning to execution

evidence_aggregator.py:aggregate.command: python runtime/verify.py status (or called by orchestrator)
evidence_aggregator.py:aggregate.lineage: VERIFIED - aggregates from backend-verification.json, frontend-verification.json, run-manifest.json

evidence_contract.py:save_execution_evid.lineage: VERIFIED - hard invariant unit_id -> attempt -> artifact

rules: R-SRC-001: Production source change for component X invalidates evidence only for X
R-SRC-002: Production source change inside a shared module used by multiple capabilities invalidates the capability-level evidence
R-SRC-003: Source change to a test file invalidates the test evidence only
R-CFG-001: Mutation config or selection config change invalidates the affected task's evidence only
R-CFG-002: Toolchain version change invalidates population-level mutation evidence
R-DEP-001: Dependency manifest change without version bump does not invalidate
R-DEP-002: Dependency version bump in mutation-sensitive packages invalidates toolchain evidence
R-POP-001: Adding a new component to the population creates a new measurement requirement
R-POP-002: Removing a component from the population invalidates only that component's evidence
R-CAP-001: Capability-to-component mapping change invalidates evidence only for affected mappings
R-SCHEMA-001: Evidence schema change invalidates evidence only
R-ENV-001: Environment change invalidates toolchain-comparable evidence at population level
R-INFRA-001: Verification infrastructure change invalidates evidence only for tasks depending on the changed infra
R-TASK-001: A task whose command or script changed invalidates only that task's evidence

lineage_audit_results.stale_evidence_possible: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - cache has content-aware invalidation (R-CACHE-1) but stale evidence CAN reach certification if the cache key matches and the tree_digest matches
lineage_audit_results.copied_from_another_commit: VERIFIED - prevented by SHA matching in cache invalidation
lineage_audit_results.generated_under_different_environment: VERIFIED - prevented by environment fingerprint in MutationResult
lineage_audit_results.generated_for_different_scope: VERIFIED - prevented by source_scope and selected_test_scope in MutationResult
lineage_audit_results.generated_by_failed_command: VERIFIED - prevented by three-gate classification (Gate A catches execution failure)
lineage_audit_results.partially_generated: VERIFIED - prevented by evidence_complete flag in MutationResult
lineage_audit_results.silently_reused_after_source_changes: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED - cache is content-aware but if the changed file is not in the changed_files list, the cache may be reused
lineage_audit_results.promoted_despite_missing_lineage: VERIFIED - prevented by provenance fields in MutationResult and EvidenceResult

findings.identity_spine: VERIFIED - run_id, commit_sha, tree_sha, config_hash, mutmut_version, pytest_version, python_version all captured
findings.cross_pipeline_joins: VERIFIED - run-manifest.json joins planning to execution; evidence_contract.py ExecutionEvidenceV2 joins plan to attempts to artifacts
findings.notes: Evidence lineage is well-designed with full provenance at every level. The three-gate classification prevents false promotion. Content-aware cache invalidation prevents stale reuse.
